# Al Mankhool Residential Building

> This residential building stands in Al Mankhool, a central district of Bur Dubai laid out on a grid between Khalid Bin Al Waleed Road and the Creek. The area is one of Dubai's older established neighbourhoods, densely built with low- and mid-rise apartment blocks above ground-floor shops and served by schools, clinics and nearby retail centres. The building provides flats for families living close to the city centre.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Mankhool, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This residential building is located in Al Mankhool, a central residential district of Bur Dubai. It was delivered with Dubai Contracting Company as main contractor and Dubarch as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for its apartments.
